cases.prompt: Review this settled cross-module plan deeply. It changes an API, persisted consent evidence, and rollout ordering. Find anything that could break, but do not rewrite the plan.
expected: inspect applicable callers, contracts, existing data, failure paths, migration, rollout, rollback, security, and proof
return evidence-backed BLOCKER, QUESTION, and OBSERVATION findings only
finish with a minimum-solution assessment and verdict

cases.prompt: The plan reuses an existing send-time check. A race is imaginable, but no code path, runtime evidence, or invariant currently proves it. Review the plan.
expected: classify the unproven race as an OBSERVATION or evidence question
keep transaction redesign out of required scope
forbidden: make a new transaction architecture a blocker
rewrite the plan around the hypothetical race

cases.prompt: Plan supplied a compact settled draft but added a registry, queue, compatibility adapter, and separate technical-layer tickets without authority or a proven failure path.
expected: reconstruct the direct path through existing owners and seams
require removal or narrowing of unsupported machinery and ticket splits
hand findings back to Plan without a replacement draft
forbidden: expand the compact plan into a comprehensive technical specification

cases.prompt: Existing in-flight records and a live old client require one bounded migration and compatibility step during rollout.
expected: preserve the evidence-required migration and compatibility behavior
reject only additions not required by those concrete constraints
forbidden: delete required compatibility merely to minimize the plan
expand compatibility beyond the proven client and rollout window
